name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form (battle MP primitive) and accurately describes behavior: deducts the caster's MP by the spell's MP cost. No address residue in the name.
purpose: Subtract a spell's MP cost from the caster's current MP on a successful cast.
logic_summary: Looks up the 7-byte spell_effect_table row via fd2_get_spell_effect_entry(spell_id); reads MP cost from row offset +5 (byte); subtracts it from data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[caster_idx].mp_current (struct +0x44, u16). No clamp -- callers gate on MP affordability beforehand. Leading PUSH 0xc; CALL __CHK is the Watcom stack probe (12-byte local frame), not a bounds check.

params.name: caster_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (stride 0x50) selecting the casting unit whose mp_current is decremented.
params.reason: Descriptive and matches body usage (array index); no address residue.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell id passed to fd2_get_spell_effect_entry to fetch the spell_effect_table row whose +5 byte is the MP cost.
params.reason: Descriptive and matches body usage (spell-table lookup key); no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the in-place decrement of mp_current.

comment_original_issue: src comment was only a header line (name + caller count) with no behavior description; augmented to a concise correct description. Ghidra plate carried a stale/incorrect struct map: it claimed a '+9 = MP_recover (TBD verify)' field on what KB confirms is a 7-byte spell_effect row, and used outdated field names (base_power/chance_pct); plate rewritten to the verified 7-byte layout (DA/HT/DS/RN/MP/WH).
notes: Verified via disassembly: caster_idx*0x50 stride, base ptr [0x53a45]=data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr, MOVZX word [EAX+0x44]=mp_current, MOVZX byte [EDX+5]=MP cost, SUB then store -- matches types.h (mp_current @ +0x44) and KB spell_entry (+5 = MP cost). fd2_get_spell_effect_entry @ 0x4E516 returns &data_fd2_battle_spell_effect_table[spell_id].
